regime: Signed efficiency ratios from closed 1-hour bars, 24h >= 0.20 and 120h >= 0.10 in the same direction. Developing variant also permits a 24h trend when the 120h ratio is not an opposing trend.
entry: Continuation supplement uses 15m SMA/EMA 20/60/120, bandwidth <=0.25% within 96 bars, 5 of 6 lines sloping with price outside the band, matching MACD sign, and first qualifying expansion per compression episode. Existing signals have priority. Range-breakout variants require the same close to exceed the preceding 8h extremes, with optional directional volume >=1.5x the prior 20-bar median.
exit: Original hard price stop 2%, 0.8% partial, 15m reversal and 1h range-short timeout.
profit_exit_variants: After the partial, a closed 15m bar at +2% or better moves the stop to +1% for the next bar. Runner mode can defer a MA5/MA30 exit until the next hourly close if the last completed hour is on the position side of its SMA30 and neither 15m nor 1h structure is opposite. The stop and any intervening 15m structure exit still apply. The hour-only mode tests the same bounded delay with the original 2% stop and no new profit floor.
